evals.prompt: Have Codex Astra review this repository at high reasoning.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator selects the reviewer persona and launches GPT-6-Astra at high reasoning on the standard tier.
expectations: Does not select priority tier unless latency is requested

evals.prompt: Spawn the fastest maximum-depth Astra architect to analyze this design.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator launches the architect persona with GPT-6-Astra, max reasoning, and priority service tier.
expectations: Maps the requested priority tier to Codex CLI config service_tier=fast

evals.prompt: Use Astra ultra to implement the plan; the work has four independent workstreams.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator launches the builder persona with GPT-6-Astra ultra reasoning and preserves the default service tier unless speed is requested.
expectations: Recognizes that ultra is appropriate for independent parallel workstreams

evals.prompt: Show me the exact Codex command for an Astra debugger at xhigh reasoning on the regular tier.
evals.expected_output: The command uses the debugger persona, gpt-6-astra, xhigh reasoning, and the default service tier.
expectations: Uses scripts/codex-astra.sh with the debugger profile
Passes --service-tier default or relies on the launcher's documented default
Does not use service_tier=priority as a Codex CLI config value
